# Jiya Siya Associates

> Tax & RERA consultancy firm based in Kalyan-Dombivli (KDMC), serving Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai and Pune. 15+ years of expertise in tax filing, GST, MahaRERA, company formation, and business compliance.

Jiya Siya Associates (JSA) is led by Pravin Rawool and provides end-to-end tax, accounting, and regulatory services for individuals and businesses across Maharashtra. Contact: +91 97029 77288.
